name: branding-giant-revopay-wordmark-behind-hand-held-phone-with-floating-transactions
title: White wordmark with a sparkle behind a silhouetted hand holding the app, with transaction cards floating out of the screen
whatItIs: A black-to-violet glow with a giant white 'RevoPay' wordmark (R with a sparkle) and a dark silhouetted hand holding a phone whose screen shows avatars orbiting the R logo, with Adobe, Figma and Sketch transaction cards floating out over the tagline 'Bringing Fiat, Crypto Into Everyday Life' and a black Get Started button.
whatItMeans: Bold and modern; the giant logo and popping cards make payments feel alive.
techniques: Put a giant wordmark behind a silhouetted hand.
Float transaction cards out of the screen.
Use a violet glow on black.

vocabulary.definition: A huge logo behind the subject.
A UI card popping out of a screen.
Profile pictures arranged around a logo.
A dark hand outline holding a device.
